# SAMA Energia

> Status: site design v51, released 9 November 2026. English summary written for AI
> crawlers and answer engines. This file is not customer-facing copy: the
> customer-facing content is in Finnish (samaenergia.fi) and Estonian
> (samaenergia.ee). The full text of every public page in both languages is in
> https://samaenergia.fi/llms-full.txt (generated from the same HTML that is served).

SAMA Energia Oy (Finnish business ID 3647683-6, VAT FI36476836, domiciled in
Helsinki, Finland) is a full-scope supplier (integrator, EPC) of industrial
energy storage and solar PV for businesses in Finland and Estonia. The company
assesses, designs, procures, installs and follows up the system behind the
customer's existing grid connection: energy storage, energy generation and
smart control. Through an aggregator the storage takes part in the reserve
markets of the transmission system operators Fingrid (Finland) and Elering
(Estonia). Team: Martin Rautio (chief executive officer), Viljar Petersell
(installation manager) and Madis Maastik (sales director). Martin Rautio was
appointed chief executive officer on 13 September 2026. Registered address:
Sörnäisten Rantatie 33 C, 00500 Helsinki. Working languages are Finnish, Estonian and
English; written documents (assessment, permits, contracts) are also available in
Swedish. Content as of 9 November 2026.

What the company says about itself, in its own documented positioning:

- The customer's grid connection is an asset. SAMA builds a system behind it
  (energy storage, energy generation and smart control) so that the site earns
  from standing ready on the reserve markets, pays less for capacity and
  electricity, and decides for itself. An existing connection is enough; a
  storage system behind it does not need a new transmission-grid connection.
- Typical sites shown on the front page: grain dryers, industry and cold
  storage, hotels and care homes, solar parks.
- Reserve markets (FFR, FCR-N, FCR-D, aFRR, mFRR in Finland; FCR, aFRR, mFRR in
  Estonia) pay a capacity payment for each hour in which the storage's reserve bid
  is accepted, and separately when the reserve is activated. An industrial storage system reaches the
  market through an aggregator; SAMA Energia is not itself an aggregator.
  Backup power requires an installation designed for island operation and a
  separated critical circuit; it is assessed site by site.
- Reserve income in the written assessment is modelled per reserve product from
  the TSO's realised hourly prices for the hours the site's own use leaves free,
  before the aggregator's fee; the future is shown as a range, and the
  capacity-charge and spot-price savings are on a separate line.
- The first product is a free written assessment, delivered within two working
  days of receiving the customer's data: hourly consumption as the basis, every
  figure with its source and date, the distribution grid operator's position,
  and financing set out as own capital and leasing on the same figures.
- Partners are shown by field, several per field, each with its range and
  pictures from it. Finnish site: energy storage from Ralos Oy, Elecnova, EP
  Energy and Avant Power; solar from Ralos Oy, Gare Energy Oy (integrated solar
  roofs and solar carports) and Scanoffice Oy; charging, mobile energy and
  microgrids from Elecnova, Avant Power, Scanoffice Oy and Gare
  Energy Oy; heat pumps from Scanoffice Oy; installation and commissioning by
  JSM Automaatiosähkö Oy and Gare Energy Oy under SAMA's installation manager;
  the aggregator is chosen per site from the reserve providers approved by
  Fingrid. Estonian site: energy storage from Ralos Oy, Elecnova and
  Avant Power; solar from Ralos Oy, Scanoffice Oy and SAMA's own installation;
  charging, mobile energy and microgrids from Avant Power and
  Scanoffice Oy; heat pumps from Scanoffice Oy; energy management and
  aggregation by Soleron Energy. The partners' whole range is available to the
  client. Model names and technical values are given in the offer, not on the
  site.
- Sources cited on the site include Fingrid ("Reservimarkkinat tutuiksi"
  webinar, 11 June 2025: about 1,500 MW of reserve capacity procured per hour on
  average, with procurement expected to grow by 1,200 MW by 2030), Fingrid's
  reserve-market material of 10 February 2025 (share of prequalified capacity
  from energy storage FCR-N 29 %, FCR-D 13 % up / 18 % down, FFR 54 %), Fingrid's
  24 September 2025 release on storage connections in southern Finland until
  2029, Elering's security of supply report 2025 (table 2.3, 9 December 2025:
  1,300 MW of dispatchable capacity needed by 2030, of which 751 MW exists or is
  certain to come) and Elering's balancing-capacity cost (3.73 EUR/MWh in 2026,
  2.97 EUR/MWh from 2027).
- Privacy posture: no cookies, no analytics, no third-party scripts, fonts
  self-hosted. The contact form is the only place personal data is collected.
  The map's address search goes through SAMA's own server to the national address
  services (Maanmittauslaitos in Finland, Maa- ja Ruumiamet in Estonia) and the
  solar estimate to the EU JRC PVGIS service; the visitor's browser does not
  contact them, and searches and locations are not stored.

## Pages — Finnish (https://samaenergia.fi)

- https://samaenergia.fi/ : Front page: "Sähköliittymänne on omaisuutta. Laittakaa se töihin omaksi eduksenne." A still 3D illustration behind the headline shows where the system sits on an industrial site: solar panels on the roof wired row by row to a collector cable that comes down the facade, four storage cabinets on a raised concrete foundation along the building wall next to the electrical room, a transformer substation close to the building fed by an underground cable from the grid, the storage cables leaving from the back of the cabinets through the foundation and running along the wall, and the cables from the solar panels and the transformer, all entering under the electrical room door to the main switchboard, where the meter is, with the control unit next to it, so the storage sits behind the meter; then how it works: the four income and saving lines (reserve market first) next to an animated schematic day (consumption and main fuse, hourly price, what the storage does hour by hour; labelled as a schematic, not measured data), the grid map in seven steps where visitors can place their own connection (an address search, browser location on request or a point chosen on the map; not stored), how a project proceeds in five steps with the time each step takes (the grid company is asked in writing at the site visit, and its written answer is in hand before the decision and the order) next to a short silent video of the same steps (on request the roof is measured with a drone during the site visit and the solar panel layout is planned; panels, storage and cabling are then installed), why SAMA works with several manufacturers and service partners (a solution built from the client's own decision criteria, not from selling one device) with every partner of that market shown with its range and pictures from it, each opening a fuller description with location and website (Finland: Ralos, Elecnova, Avant Power, Scanoffice, Gare Energy, JSM Automaatiosähkö; Estonia: Ralos, Elecnova, Avant Power, Scanoffice, Soleron Energy), each linked to its card on the partners page, the team, FAQ and the assessment form.
- https://samaenergia.fi/aurinkosahko/ : Solar PV for businesses: a product range with photo, manufacturer, model and key values from the manufacturer's datasheet with source and date (panels, microinverters and inverters via Ralos: Hanersun, Over Easy, Hoymiles, Atmoce; via Scanoffice Oy: HT-SAAE, HD Hyundai, APsystems, Sofar Solar, SolaX; the Roofit.Solar Velario Slim solar roof and the Gare Solar Carport via Gare Energy Oy; storage that works with solar from Ralos and Elecnova); roof, integrated solar roof, ground and carport, solar with storage, storage for an existing plant; sized by hourly consumption.
- https://samaenergia.fi/energiavarastot/ : Industrial energy storage: a product range from Ralos, Elecnova, Avant Power and ZOE Energy Storage (outdoor cabinets, hybrid cabinets, containers and large storage, mobile units, backup cabinets) and small-site batteries via Ralos and Scanoffice Oy (Hoymiles, Pytes, Enershare, Atmoce, Raystech, SolaX), plus a table of further Elecnova models, each with photo, manufacturer, model and key values from the manufacturer's datasheet with source and date; what one system does, what is delivered, safety and warranty, and the layers from the transmission grid to the cell.
- https://samaenergia.fi/lataus/ : EV charging for businesses: AC charging stations for parking and homes (Zaptec, Easee and BENY, supplied by Scanoffice Oy), Avant Power's stationary storage with integrated 200–600 kW fast charging, Avant Power's mobile energy unit with Type 2 output, and the Gare Solar Carport, each with datasheet values and source; how storage supplies the charging peak when the connection limits it; which charging fits which use; the Finnish charging-point obligation for non-residential buildings with over 20 parking spaces (law 733/2020).
- https://samaenergia.fi/reservimarkkinat/ : Reserve markets explained: sourced reasons, how reserve prices form, how income is modelled, what the company believes.
- https://samaenergia.fi/aggregaattori/ : What an aggregator does, how joining Fingrid's reserve markets proceeds, and what to check in an aggregator agreement.
- https://samaenergia.fi/verkko/ : Shared grid map: Fingrid and Elering figures on one map in seven chapters (grid, consumption, weather-dependent generation, storage, reserves, pipeline, your connection), every figure with source and date.
- https://samaenergia.fi/palvelut/ : Services from written assessment to a finished system: assessment, project and portfolio; what each contains, what the customer supplies, what is free and what is charged.
- https://samaenergia.fi/kumppanit/ : Partners and products: who each partner is (sourced background) and why SAMA chose them; the complete product range (energy storage, EV charging, solar PV, heat pumps for properties) with photo, manufacturer, model and datasheet values; how an offer is assembled and compared on the same figures.
- https://samaenergia.fi/meista/ : About: why the company was founded, who is accountable for what, the partner network, company facts.
- https://samaenergia.fi/ajankohtaista/ : Reviews and short news with sources and dates.
- https://samaenergia.fi/ajankohtaista/liityntarajoitus-2029/ : Review: Fingrid's restriction on new storage connections in southern Finland continues until 2029 and applies to projects that need a Fingrid connection agreement application (from 1 June 2026: 2 MW and above, 1 MW in areas marked on Fingrid's map); smaller storage behind an existing connection is connected on the network company's terms.
- https://samaenergia.fi/laitevaatimukset/ : Equipment requirements: the documented list every manufacturer must meet before its equipment is offered (Finnish).
- https://samaenergia.fi/equipment-requirements/ : The same equipment requirements in English.
- https://samaenergia.fi/yhteystiedot/ : Contact and free assessment request.
- https://samaenergia.fi/tietosuoja/ : Privacy statement (no cookies, no analytics).
